text:
miko: heads-up onboarding Cust-Cygnet LoRA 'Cygni' into staging. quick int4 smoke shows weird exponent shifts on amounts (small cents -> thousands). posting minimal logs.
miko: example:
```
pred: "Paid: $3,200"
truth: "Paid: $32.00"
```
rana: that usually indicates tokenizer id collision or adapter vocab aliasing. which tokenizer + merge?
miko: used stitch merge alpha=0.4, bias-corr on. tokenizer: redwood-core-3.2.2 patched; adapter vocab from customer.
jorge: running tokenmap diff + embed drift. also fire a quickpack: `rundelta --pack cygni --quant int4 --eval invoices-mini-l10n`
ci-bot: job started: cygni-quickpack-int4 id cg-7100 by jorge.
jorge: quickpack topline:
- overall acc: base 0.80 -> cygni int4 0.72
- numeric F1: 0.65 -> 0.52
- main fail: magnitude x10/x100 on many rows
miko: tokenmap diff shows comma/dot swapped and a THOUSAND token present in adapter at different id.
tara: quick triage plan: A) remap adapter ids to base and re-eval; B) try hybrid quant (int8 for first 4 layers, int4 rest) with 64-sample act-calib; C) add tokenmap_check to onboarding CI.
jorge: kicked two jobs: cg-7101 (remap + overlay 0.9/0.1) and cg-7102 (remap + hybrid-int8 + calib64).
ci-bot: jobs cg-7101/cg-7102 started.
jorge: results:
- cg-7101 remap+overlay: numeric F1 0.59, error down to 2x
- cg-7102 remap+hybrid-int8+calib64: numeric F1 0.63, error ~1.05x (near baseline)
rana: signals point to token id aliasing as primary root cause; hybrid-int8 recovers under int4 storage.
tara: will draft a short customer note recommending hybrid-int8 canary + tokenmap preflight; fallback float16 shadow if canary fails.
miko: opening PR to add tokenmap_check in adapter CI and a runtime remap toggle. thanks all.
